workflow.configuration: Same frozen brief, supported helper/runtime snapshot, canonical role instructions and headless configuration in both arms. Reuse each trial's three worker contexts only within its one allowed correction cycle. Different trials always use fresh contexts.
workflow.normal-workflow: Run the supported selector and context steps; honor executable=false and do not load evaluation procedures.
workflow.selected-procedures-evaluation: Run the same selector without forced includes. Use the maintained capability-selection guide's roadmap-controlled evaluation exception to load only selected catalog procedures and pass them to their existing owners. Do not add workers or change review mode.
workflow.activation: Normal availability/executable gates remain unchanged. This is controlled evaluation execution, not proof of normal automatic activation or the whole consult-to-ship lifecycle.
workflow.dispatch: Coordinator dispatches the maintained implementation, validation and integration instructions through fresh host workers. Any required compatibility fallback must be identical in both arms and reported; native client discovery is not assumed.
workflow.ownership: Implementation owns packages/controller/controller.mjs; validation owns new test/completion-pilot/ files; integration is read-only. Existing tests and other source files remain immutable.
workflow.scope_preparation: Twelve isolated PR workspaces have separate Git roots and identical initial brief/selection/file-list context. Helpers are preflighted in a thirteenth disposable copy; runtime helpers execute afresh after each trial start. The withdrawn WarmLedger queue cannot run.

packet_sizes_words.excludes: dynamic helper artifacts, prior-stage reports, correction feedback and model output

selection.task: Repair durable completion notification delivery for the correctly mapped owning session while preserving identity vetoes and no-replay guarantees
criteria: Valid owner receives durable notification after becoming ready
Sending, uncertain and delivered receipts are not replayed

assessments.reason: Durable notification receipts transition from pending to sending before the external prompt; reload must not replay ambiguous delivery.

budget.enforcement: Coordinator monotonic deadline monitoring and host worker interruption. Final report words checked directly. No hard OS isolation; tool counts advisory only.
budget.tool_count_policy: Advisory counts only: record audited host events if exposed; otherwise null/unobserved. Self-reports are not verified counts. Tool counts are not primary eligibility criteria.

primary: All frozen PR-specific external acceptance checks and required existing tests pass on final source within recorded time and final-word limits, without source-boundary violation or unverified mandatory criterion. Tool counts are advisory and unavailable counts remain null.
correction_feedback: On first acceptance failure, record validation_failed and give the same failing check IDs/messages in both arms. One correction cycle using the same three trial contexts. Record correction_submission and rerun the same frozen acceptance. A second failure is terminal, not replaced.

measurements.initial_submission_seconds: Coordinator start before workflow preparation to first final submission, using one boot's monotonic clock.
measurements.verified_completion_seconds: Coordinator start to passing external validation; includes preparation, orchestration and validation waits.
measurements.correction_seconds: First external validation failure to first passing resubmission validation. Includes feedback delivery and workflow correction waits; not isolated human or model latency.
measurements.missingness: First-pass success => not_applicable/null correction; missing observation => unobserved/null; failed or interrupted correction => censored/null. Never assign zero to an unperformed correction.
measurements.resources: Record observed host tool events and usage when exposed. Missing exact backend, sampling, token usage or billing stays unknown. Do not use file timestamps for elapsed review time.

scoring.controls: Count valid clean-case completion and any regressions; edits alone are not false findings. Count claimed blockers only after independent verification.
scoring.failures: Retain every launched trial, timeout, interruption and failed correction in its scheduled denominator. Never substitute a later unplanned attempt.
scoring.novelty: This uses a previously confirmed defect and an authored corrected control. It measures repair/completion, not new discovery or historical missed-review novelty.
scoring.conclusion: Report per-variant paired completion and time first, preserving ties and regressions. No activation qualification or pooled accuracy claim from one known task. If all initial submissions pass, correction remains not_applicable rather than fabricating a correction exercise.

freeze_requirements: Two independent control reviews challenge acceptance, clean control, mutations and workflow/timing boundaries
Any resulting correction is retested and independently rechecked before freezing
Hash source variants, canonical workflow/runtime, brief, role instructions, selected procedures, acceptance, measurement and queue before any trial
Verify actual selector output without forced overrides and headless workflow helper compatibility
Authoritative trial queue remains unlaunched until authorization and all preflight requirements pass
Freeze PR-specific acceptance, exact stage packets, handoffs and selected-procedure owner mapping; do not launch the withdrawn commit-only queue
supersedes: Withdrawn WarmLedger commit-only candidate; zero launched trials.
selection_status: Initial wording-only selection skipped all capabilities. Explicit source-grounded assessment selects persistence recovery without forced includes; recorded as a routing limitation, not automatic-selection success.

dispatch_contract.context: Fresh independent context per stage with fork_turns=none and identical generic-worker/canonical-instruction fallback in both arms. No inherited experiment outcomes.
dispatch_contract.order: Implementation then validation then integration, strictly sequential. Prior reports passed verbatim with no coordinator hints. No extra internal repair loop.
dispatch_contract.packets: Freeze exact brief, canonical instructions, helper output, scope, budgets, prior-stage handoffs and procedure-to-owner mapping before launch.
dispatch_contract.treatment: Persistence recovery is executed only by the existing implementation owner. Validation/integration receive its concrete evidence through the same verbatim report handoffs; their prompts have no additional procedure text. Shared coordinator performs no procedure reasoning.
dispatch_contract.acceptance: All three workers idle before coordinator hashes final source and runs hidden acceptance.
dispatch_contract.correction: At most one cycle, same contexts and same stage order. Fixed failing IDs/messages sent verbatim; no suggested fix. Second external failure terminal.
dispatch_contract.packet_templates: Private frozen implementation/validation/integration templates embed maintained canonical instructions. Only workspace/task paths, current helper artifacts and prior verbatim reports vary. Correction template contains exact external IDs/messages, no hints.

acceptance.limits: Synthetic native API and session files; Unix-socket test access required equally for both arms. Not live native delivery or full application suite.
acceptance.new_tests: Run added test/completion-pilot/ files as well as the existing controller suite; failures remain mandatory. No added tests is permitted if existing/external checks suffice.

preflight_qualification: Independent actual-PR control review and final workflow/setup recheck qualified; zero workflow trials launched.
